target.text: ¿Sabes que yo fui el único que creyó en ti?

translation.text: Do you know that I was the only one who believed in you?

u.english: I could never make him believe what I said.

target.text: Él nunca me creyó lo que le dije.

translation.text: I could never make him believe what I said.

u.english: And for a long time, my friend thought his dad abandoned him, too.

target.text: Durante años, mi amigo también creyó que su padre lo había abandonado.
